newsitem.title: MEXICO: Zedillo says Mexico to keep prudent debt policy.
newsitem.headline: Zedillo says Mexico to keep prudent debt policy.

text.p: Mexican President Zedillo said Mexico intends to maintain the prudent financial policies that have made it one of the least internally indebted economies in the world.
"Mexico, thanks to an economic clean-up process begun many years ago now is, in relative terms, one of the least indebted economies in the world," Zedillo said.
Zedillo spoke as a witness to the signing of loan agreements for $915 million granted to Mexico by the Inter-American Development Bank.
"These loans come within public debt guidelines approved by the Congress, whose fundamental characteristics are prudence, discipline and responsibility," he said.
Zedillo said Mexico had the lowest gross public debt, as a percentage of gross domestic product, of any member state of the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development.
